statement: The rank-two construction has the following properties. (i) At period data induced by a rational orthogonal decomposition W = W1 ⊥ W2, the form ΞW(ϕ) is holomorphic. On a sufficiently deep common principal quotient it is a finite sum, with constant coefficients, of forms Θ1(ϕ1,r) ∧ Θ2(ϕ2,r). (ii) There is an input which is a product in adapted rational coordinates and for which ΞW(ϕ) is nonzero. (iii) Fix W, the total finite input ϕ, and a torsion-free principal quotient X whose finite level fixes ϕ under ωW,f . With locally smooth constant-line trivializations, the map t 7−→ ΞW(ϕ; t) is continuous in the C∞ topology of differential forms on this fixed compact quotient. The same finite level works throughout the parameter neighborhood.
